description.de: Prüft Hunt-Daten auf Fehler und Warnungen — blockiert Release bei kritischen Fehlern
description.en: Validates hunt data for errors and warnings — blocks release on critical errors

config.label: Hunt-Daten QA analysieren
config.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/flo/Entwicklung/IdeaProjects/treasure_hunt_level
python3 scripts/qa_analyze_hunts.py hunts/Bahnorte/ 2>&1 | tee /tmp/hunt_qa_result.txt

ERRORS=$(grep -cE '^ERROR|Fehler:' /tmp/hunt_qa_result.txt || echo 0)
WARNINGS=$(grep 'Warnungen:' /tmp/hunt_qa_result.txt | grep -oP '\d+' | head -1 || echo 0)

echo ''
echo "--- QA Summary ---"
echo "Errors: $ERRORS"
echo "Warnings: $WARNINGS"

if [ "$ERRORS" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "gate_status: RED"
  echo "gate_category: hunt-data"
  echo "gate_description: $ERRORS Fehler in Hunt-Daten — Release blockiert"
  exit 1
elif [ "$WARNINGS" -gt 3000 ]; then
  echo "gate_status: YELLOW"
  echo "gate_category: hunt-data"
  echo "gate_description: $WARNINGS Warnungen — Release möglich, aber Qualität prüfen"
else
  echo "gate_status: GREEN"
  echo "gate_category: hunt-data"
  echo "gate_description: Daten OK ($WARNINGS Warnungen)"
fi
